title: Mexican Casserole
description: A classic Mexican-inspired casserole with ground beef, cheese, and a crunchy topping.
instructions: Brown the ground beef in a skillet over medium-high heat until fully cooked.
Add the savory and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the American cheese until melted.
In a separate bowl, mix the casserole cheese mix and shredded cheddar.
In a 9x13 inch baking dish, create a layer of the ground beef mixture.
Top with a layer of the cheese mixture.
Repeat the layers one more time, ending with the cheese on top.
Sprinkle crushed tortilla chips and chopped cilantro on top.
Bake for 25 minutes or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from oven and top with a dollop of sour cream.
